visualCharacteristics.purpose: Two equal portrait image teasers side by side, each with an overlaid title and CTA, stacking on mobile
visualCharacteristics.description: Two equal 4:5 image teasers side by side with no gap-heavy styling; heading and SHOP NOW pill (white bg, #222 text) overlaid at the bottom of each image; stack vertically on mobile; each teaser clickable.

contentPattern.name: two-up image teasers
contentPattern.structure: one row with one cell per teaser; each cell: image (desktop picture, then optional mobile crop), h2 title, SHOP NOW link
contentPattern.blockContent: One row, two columns. Each column: image (desktop picture then optional mobile crop), h2 title, SHOP NOW link.

usage: Use for a two-up pair of editorial teasers.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any side-by-side image teasers with an overlaid CTA; more than two cells render as equal columns.
